dct_description_sm: Senegal administrative level 0 edge-matched gazetteer, shapefiles, and geodatabase. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-sen); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. These layers are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Senegal- Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-sen) tables. Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID.
dct_publisher_sm: Government of Senegal, 2009 (updated by OCHA/ROWCA) 04 august 2018
